title: An oversized assignee or title could fail every catalog search in its project
outcome: An oversized assignee or title could fail every catalog search in its project
acceptance: A focused test shows whether one item with planning text over the catalog's 1 MiB unit limit fails searches that wouldn't select it; if it does, the text is bounded at write or the search no longer reads it, and such searches succeed.

completion.summary: Landed as 6dd431e3 and installed (build 7854af2c). A catalog search no longer fails because of one item it doesn't return whose text is over the 1 MiB unit limit. Search skips over-limit values: octet_length guards on keys, assignee and availability, the FTS id read from the content table, TOOBIG caught for successor details, `--under` resolved by id. Agent writes refuse new text whose stored form or blocker a returning search couldn't read; task-sync writes are never refused. Evidence: a probe showed the failure, a 16-row read-path table was checked by both final reviewers, focused tests run such searches and assert success, FULL test-bfe45da8 passed all 12 stages, and independent evaluation eb495117 passed. Follow-ups: w-d08bea7b4df5 (note refs), w-f2aeddce2070 (label test).
